title: Tecsys TS9090-HD H.264/MPEG-2 Encoder
excerpt: Suitable for ISDB-T digital terrestrial TV transmission. It has two ASI inputs that can receive TS or BTS. Built-in 10MHz high-precision oscillator with 10MHz external input option. Output 44MHz with digital pre-corrector. Fully developed in Brazil, it is mounted in a 19 "aluminum cabinet, with an active ventilation unit and a friendly user interface via front panel keys and LCD display.
body:
TS9090-HD encodes audio and video signals in H.264 HD generating output stream (TS) in ASI standard, compliant with DVB and ISDB-T standards. With an algorithm of very high efficiency allows services in high definition and high quality with rates lower than 4Mbps, allowing savings in bandwidth, with ASI output and TSoIP Ethernet.

Main Features:

MULTIPLEXER

Management and insertion of DVB / ISDB-T tables PSI: PAT, PMT, SDT and NIT

Closed Caption Digital (VBI)

Configuration and Management

Embedded web server configuration system

Front panel with LCD and keyboard

HD VIDEO

Compression: Main stream HD MPEG-4 AVC / H.264 (MP and HP @ L4.1) and MPEG-2 HD

Resolution: 1280x720p / 1920x1080i / 1920x1080p

Encoding bit rate 1.3 at 25 Mbps

Frame Rates: 23.97, 24.25, 29.97, 30.50 and 59.94 and 60 (fps)

Input: HDMI, YPrPb and HD-SDI

N ° of Services: An HD service

SD VIDEO

Compression: Main stream SD MPEG-4 AVC / H.264 and MPEG-2 SD

Resolution: 720x480i (NTSC) / 720x576i (PAL)

Encoding Bit rate: 1.0 to 25 Mbps

Frame Rates: 25 and 29.97 (fps)

Input: HDMI, YPrPb and HD-SDI

No. of Services: An SD service

VIDEO 1SEG

Compression: Main stream 1-Seg MPEG-4 AVC / H.264

Resolution: 352x288i / 352x288p / 320x240p / 320x180p / 160x120p and 160x90p

Encoding Bit rate: up to 0.25 Mbps

Frame Rates: 5, 10, 15, 24, 29.97 and 30 (fps)

Input: HDMI, YPrPb and HD-SDI

N ° of Services: 1-Seg service
